overview.en: Parliament has a Chamber of Deputies of 200 members elected proportionally for four years and a Senate of 81 members elected by majority vote for six years, one third every two years. The Government is responsible to the Chamber of Deputies alone; the President has been directly elected since the rule in force on 1 October 2012.
overview.zh: 议会由众议院（200 名议员，比例代表制，任期四年）和参议院（81 名参议员，多数制，任期六年，每两年改选三分之一）组成。政府仅对众议院负责；自 2012 年 10 月 1 日生效的规则起，总统由选民直选。

constitution.official_name: Ústava České republiky (ústavní zákon č. 1/1993 Sb.)

name.en: Constitution of the Czech Republic (Constitutional Act No. 1/1993 Coll.)
name.zh: 捷克共和国宪法（第 1/1993 号宪法性法律）

note.en: e-Sbírka informative consolidated version effective from 1 January 2026.
note.zh: e-Sbírka 系统 2026 年 1 月 1 日起生效的参考合并文本。

label.en: Universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot, on the principles of proportional representation
label.zh: 普遍、平等、直接选举，秘密投票，依比例代表原则

powers.en: Grants and withdraws confidence in the Government (Arts. 68, 72) and has the last word on ordinary bills (Art. 47).
powers.zh: 给予和撤回对政府的信任（第 68、72 条），对普通法案拥有最终决定权（第 47 条）。

label.en: Universal, equal and direct suffrage on majoritarian principles; 81 single-member districts, two rounds if no absolute majority
label.zh: 普遍、平等、直接选举，依多数制原则；81 个单议席选区，未获绝对多数时举行两轮

powers.en: Within 30 days approves, rejects or amends a bill or declares it will not deal with it; the Chamber of Deputies overrides rejection or amendments by a majority of all deputies (Arts. 46–47).
powers.zh: 在 30 日内批准、否决或修改法案，或声明不予审议；众议院可以全体议员过半数推翻否决或修改（第 46–47 条）。

note.en: One third of senators is elected every two years, so the Senate is never renewed as a whole.
note.zh: 每两年改选三分之一参议员，参议院从不整体改选。

label.en: Direct election; an absolute majority of valid votes, otherwise a second round of the two leading candidates 14 days later
label.zh: 直接选举；须获有效票绝对多数，否则 14 日后在得票前两名之间举行第二轮

term_limit.en: No one may be elected more than twice in succession
term_limit.zh: 任何人不得连续当选两次以上

label.en: Appointed by the President; the Government must win the Chamber's confidence within 30 days
label.zh: 由总统任命；政府须在 30 日内获得众议院信任

label.en: Republic
label.zh: 共和国

label.en: Unitary state
label.zh: 单一制国家

label.en: Parliamentary republic
label.zh: 议会共和制

detail.en: The Government is responsible to the Chamber of Deputies (Art. 68(1)); the President is directly elected but not accountable for the exercise of office (Art. 54(3)).
detail.zh: 政府对众议院负责（第 68 条第 1 款）；总统直选，但不对其职务行为负责（第 54 条第 3 款）。

label.en: Bicameral: Chamber of Deputies and Senate
label.zh: 两院制：众议院与参议院

label.en: Direct popular vote since 1 October 2012
label.zh: 自 2012 年 10 月 1 日起选民直选

detail.en: Before that date the President was elected by Parliament at a joint session of both chambers.
detail.zh: 此前总统由议会两院联席会议选举。

label.en: 5 years; at most two consecutive terms
label.zh: 五年；至多连任两届

label.en: President appoints; Government seeks the Chamber's confidence within 30 days
label.zh: 总统任命；政府须在 30 日内请求众议院信任

detail.en: If the first Government fails, the procedure is repeated; if the second also fails, the President appoints a Prime Minister proposed by the Speaker of the Chamber of Deputies.
detail.zh: 首届政府未获信任时程序重复一次；第二次仍失败，总统依众议院议长提议任命总理。

steps.en: President appoints the Prime Minister and, on the Prime Minister's proposal, the ministers
steps.zh: 总统任命总理，并依总理提议任命部长

steps.en: Government asks the Chamber of Deputies for confidence within 30 days
steps.zh: 政府在 30 日内请求众议院信任

label.en: Required: Chamber of Deputies vote of confidence
label.zh: 须经众议院信任投票

label.en: Motion by at least 50 deputies; majority of all deputies
label.zh: 至少 50 名议员提出；须全体议员过半数

label.en: Government may link confidence to a bill (Art. 35(1)(b))
label.zh: 政府可将信任问题与法案挂钩（第 35 条第 1 款 b 项）

label.en: President may dissolve the Chamber in four listed cases, and must on a three-fifths Chamber resolution
label.zh: 总统可在四种列明情形下解散众议院，众议院以五分之三多数决议时必须解散

detail.en: Cases: no confidence in a Government appointed on the Speaker's proposal; no decision within three months on a Government bill tied to confidence; session suspended too long; Chamber inquorate for over three months. Not in the last three months of the term.
detail.zh: 情形：依议长提议任命的政府未获信任；与信任挂钩的政府法案三个月内未表决；会议中断超过允许期限；众议院连续三个月以上无法形成决议。任期最后三个月内不得解散。

label.en: President may return a law within 15 days; Chamber overrides by a majority of all deputies
label.zh: 总统可在 15 日内退回法律；众议院以全体议员过半数推翻

detail.en: Not available for constitutional acts; no amendments are allowed in the repeat vote.
detail.zh: 不适用于宪法性法律；重新表决时不得修改。

label.en: Senate revises within 30 days; Chamber overrides by a majority of all deputies
label.zh: 参议院 30 日内审议；众议院以全体议员过半数推翻

label.en: Constitutional Court (Ústavní soud), 15 judges appointed for ten years
label.zh: 宪法法院（Ústavní soud），15 名法官，任期十年

label.en: Chamber 4 years; Senate 6 years, staggered
label.zh: 众议院四年；参议院六年，交错改选

label.en: Chamber: list PR in 14 regions with two scrutinies; Senate: two-round majority in 81 districts
label.zh: 众议院：14 个选区名单比例代表制，两级计票；参议院：81 个选区两轮多数制

summary.en: List proportional representation in 14 regions with a regional and a national scrutiny
summary.zh: 14 个选区的名单比例代表制，分地区和全国两级计票

allocation.en: First scrutiny: regional quota (votes ÷ (seats + 2)); remaining seats in a national second scrutiny (election rule record for 2021 and 2025)
allocation.zh: 第一级计票：地区配额（票数 ÷（席位数 + 2））；剩余席位在全国第二级计票中分配（见 2021 和 2025 年选举规则记录）

electoral_systems.legal_basis: Act No. 247/1995 Coll. on elections to the Parliament of the Czech Republic

summary.en: Two-round majority voting in 81 single-member districts
summary.zh: 81 个单议席选区两轮多数制

constituencies.zh: 81 个单议席选区（第 59 条）

allocation.en: A candidate with an absolute majority of valid votes in the first round is elected (§ 75); otherwise the two leading candidates meet in a second round starting on the sixth day after the first (§ 76)
allocation.zh: 第一轮获有效票绝对多数者当选（第 75 条）；否则得票前两名在首轮结束后第六日开始的第二轮中对决（第 76 条）

title.en: Constitution of the Czech Republic takes effect

new.en: Bicameral Parliament (Chamber of Deputies and Senate), Government responsible to the Chamber, Constitutional Court.
new.zh: 两院制议会（众议院与参议院）、对众议院负责的政府、宪法法院。

previous.en: President elected by Parliament at a joint session of both chambers; a candidate needed a majority of all deputies and of all senators (Arts. 54(2), 58, version 14 September 2009 – 30 September 2012).
previous.zh: 总统由议会两院联席会议选举；候选人须同时获得全体众议员和全体参议员的过半数（第 54 条第 2 款、第 58 条，2009 年 9 月 14 日至 2012 年 9 月 30 日文本）。

new.en: President elected directly (Art. 54(2)); two-round majority system (Art. 56).
new.zh: 总统由选民直接选举（第 54 条第 2 款）；两轮多数制（第 56 条）。

changes.legal_basis: Constitutional Act No. 71/2012 Coll.; version of the Constitution effective 1 October 2012

title.en: Chamber of Deputies: two scrutinies and lower coalition thresholds
title.zh: 众议院：两级计票与较低的联盟门槛

effective_note.en: Between the 2017 and 2021 elections; the 2021 rule record reads the Act in its version from 1 July 2021.
effective_note.zh: 介于 2017 与 2021 年选举之间；2021 年规则记录所读为 2021 年 7 月 1 日起的法律文本。

previous.en: 2017 election: one scrutiny by successive divisors within each region; thresholds 5% / 10% / 15% / 20% by number of coalition members.
previous.zh: 2017 年选举：各选区内按连续除数一级计票；按联盟成员数，门槛为 5%/10%/15%/20%。

new.en: 2021 and 2025 elections: regional quota plus national scrutiny; thresholds 5% / 8% / 11%.
new.zh: 2021 和 2025 年选举：地区配额加全国计票；门槛为 5%/8%/11%。

changes.legal_basis: Act 247/1995 Coll., versions read for the 2017 (13 April 2017 – 18 May 2018) and 2021 (from 1 July 2021) election rule records

note.en: Derived from the stored election rule records; the amending act and its effective date were not read, so the change is placed between the 2017 and 2021 elections only.
note.zh: 依已存选举规则记录推定；修正法及其生效日期未阅读，因此仅确定变化发生在 2017 与 2021 年选举之间。

reason.en: Apart from the 2012 presidential change, per-article version dates were not read.
reason.zh: 除 2012 年总统选举变化外，逐条版本日期未阅读。
